episodes.synopsis: It's launch day for one of the most highly-anticipated video games of all time. Join the character "Kirito" as he begins his journey in the virtual world of Sword Art Online.
episodes.title: The World of Swords

episodes.synopsis: It’s been one month since the players have been locked in the game.  2000 people have died; the first floor hasn’t been cleared yet.
episodes.title: Beater

episodes.synopsis: Kirito has finally joined a guild made up of close friends in reality.  Everything is going well until a tragic accident changes Kirito completely.
episodes.title: The Red-Nosed Reindeer

episodes.synopsis: Silca is known as Dragon Tamer Silca, but after leaving her group she is caught and her pet, Pina paid the ultimate price.  Before she is killed, Kirito saves her and offers her a choice.
episodes.title: The Black Swordsman

episodes.synopsis: A player has been killed inside a safe zone and not by the known means.  Asuna and Krito take it upon themselves to find out how and why this is happening.
episodes.title: Murder in the Safe Zone

episodes.synopsis: Kirito has figured out the how and now he has to figure out the why.
episodes.title: Illusionary Avenger

episodes.synopsis: A trip to get a new sword leaves Kirito battling a dragon and his fears.
episodes.title: The Temperature of the Heart

episodes.synopsis: After 2 years, people have got used to living in SAO, with a dwindling front line it might just be up to Kirito and Asuna to continue the charge.
episodes.title: The Sword Dance of Black and White

episodes.synopsis: To save a group of players and Asuna from a Boss character, Kirito is forced to play his trump card.
episodes.title: The Blue-Eyed Demon

episodes.synopsis: Kirito has agreed to a duel with the head of the Blood Alliance Knights.  If Kirito wins, Asuna is free to leave the Knights and if he loses…
episodes.title: Crimson Killing Intent

episodes.synopsis: The newly married couple is enjoying their time away from the front lines.  But a new guest will take them all the way back to the beginning.
episodes.title: The Girl of Morning Dew

episodes.synopsis: Yulier, second in command, of the Liberation Army has approached Kirito and Asuna for help saving her friend and her guild.
episodes.title: Yui's Heart

episodes.synopsis: While enjoying a fishing tournment Kirito receieves an urgent e-mail from the leader of the guild requesting their return.
episodes.title: Edge of Hell's Abyss

episodes.synopsis: Game over.
episodes.title: The End of the World

episodes.synopsis: Kirigaya is adjusting to his life outside of the game, but he hasn't forgotten about Asuna. A recent visit to her in the hospital, he meets Sugou Nobuyuki.
episodes.title: Return

episodes.synopsis: A new MMO allows users to fly and encourages player killing. Kirito has joined this new game in search of Asuna and is pleasantly surprised with what he finds.
episodes.title: Land of the Fairies

episodes.synopsis: As Kirito learns about the game from Leafa and the hatred between the races, Asuna learns the truth of her role from the Fairy King.
episodes.title: Captive Queen

episodes.synopsis: Leafa is making enemies leaving her area and group to team up with Kirito. On their way to neutral Territory, they speak more of the rules and areas of the ALO.
episodes.title: To the World Tree

episodes.synopsis: Something isn’t right; Recon has sent Leafa a message “I was right. Be careful. S."  What does he mean and will Leafa and Kirito have the time to figure it out?
episodes.title: The Lugru Corridor

episodes.synopsis: Kirito and Leafa have made it to the meeting and Kirito’s bluff as an ambassador has been called out.  If he can survive in a fight against the Salamanders General Eugene, his plan to prevent a war might work.
episodes.title: General of the Blazing Flame

episodes.synopsis: While Asuna continues her attempt to escape, another woman in Kirito’s life tries to make sense of her emotions.
episodes.title: The Truth about Alfheim

episodes.synopsis: Kirito’s determination to save Asuna borders on the insane.  His reckless is stopped when Leafa suddenly logs out.
episodes.title: Grand Quest

episodes.synopsis: Even though a wall has been built between Kirito and Sugu, he must save Asuna.  The next time he challenges the final dungeon he won’t be alone.
episodes.title: Bonds

episodes.synopsis: Kirito, Asuna, and Yui are finally together again, but the locks placed on Asuna are unbreakable.  Before they have a chance to come up with a plan, the fairy king makes his grand entrance.
episodes.title: Gilded Hero

episodes.synopsis: Kirigaya Kazuto has beaten death twice but there is one more thing he must do.
episodes.title: The World Seed
